A_h3.label: CDR-H3 focused
A_h3.where: edits concentrated in CDR-H3, the antibody's main binding loop
A_h3.why: published work reports CDR-H3 as the most productive region to mature
A_h3.result: scored WORST here, contradicting that expectation

B_interface.label: Contact region
B_interface.where: edits on or beside residues that physically touch HER2, excluding CDR-H3
B_interface.why: changes near the interface can improve complementarity without touching H3
B_interface.result: second best; produced two of the significant designs

C_mixed.label: Mixed
C_mixed.where: a few edits near the contact surface plus supporting edits elsewhere
C_mixed.why: tests whether distant changes can reinforce a contact-region change
C_mixed.result: produced the most statistically significant designs

D_framework.label: Scaffold only
D_framework.where: edits only in the structural framework; the binding site is left untouched
D_framework.why: a deliberate control: can we change the molecule without disturbing binding?
D_framework.result: best average interface quality, and the safest edits

claim_boundary: ipSAE is interface confidence from a structure predictor, not a binding affinity. No K_D is predicted.
